 Commercial News 
 The Wanderers are hitting the road, but the Red & Black atmosphere is staying right here in Western Sydney!
 Western Sydney Wanderers Members and fans are invited to come together at DOOLEYS Regent St Pavilion this Saturday night for an official Away Day Watch Party as the Wanderers take on Melbourne City in Matchweek 4 of the A-League Men season.
 With Ufuk Talay’s side looking to extend their unbeaten start to the campaign, there’s no better way to experience the action than alongside fellow Wanderers fans.
 Whether you’re a regular at Wanderland or looking for somewhere to catch the match with your mates, DOOLEYS Regent St Pavilion is the place to be as the Red & Black chase another three points on the road.
 Grab a drink, enjoy a bite to eat and settle in for a big night of football as the Wanderers look to bring the points back to Western Sydney.
 AWAY DAY WATCH PARTY DETAILS 
 Fixture:  Melbourne City v Western Sydney Wanderers
 Date:  Saturday 7 November 2026
 Kick-off:  7:40pm AEDT
 Venue:  DOOLEYS Regent St Pavilion
 Pull on your Red & Black, round up your mates and bring the Wanderland atmosphere to DOOLEYS.
 The boys might be playing in Melbourne, but Western Sydney will be right behind them.
 See you there!
